description: This file defines the KiloCode class, an extension of the OpenRouter class, implementing a specialized LLM provider with KiloCode-specific features such as custom headers, dynamic metadata, and integration with an FIM provider.

classes.name: KiloCode
classes.description: A class extending OpenRouter to provide KiloCode-specific LLM functionalities, including custom headers, per-request metadata, and FIM support.

methods.name: _streamChat
methods.description: Overrides parent method to extract per-request metadata and stream chat messages.

methods.name: _streamComplete
methods.description: Overrides parent method to handle per-request metadata during completion streaming.

methods.name: _streamFim
methods.description: Delegates FIM streaming to the IFimProvider, managing per-request metadata.

methods.name: _getHeaders
methods.description: Injects KiloCode-specific headers, including version and optional metadata headers from FIM provider.

methods.name: supportsFim
methods.description: Indicates whether FIM is supported based on the FimProvider.
